correctness.rationale: The source pencil maps t to parameter kappa(t)=t^-3-t^4, giving the known collision polynomial after factoring kappa(x)-kappa(y) by y-x. Substituting y=sx shows B birational to t^7=-(s²+s+1)/(s³(s+1)(s²+1)). At characteristics away from 2,3,7, the rational function has seven distinct branch places with valuations (1,1,-3,-1,-1,-1,4); gcd(valuation,7)=1, so the degree-seven geometric Kummer extension is connected and totally ramified at seven places. Riemann–Hurwitz gives g=15. Degree-nine plane arithmetic genus28 yields delta sum13 and Weil plus delta bounds gives #B(Fq)>=q+1-30sqrt(q)-13. For gcd(7,q-1)=1, seventh powering permutes Fq^×, giving exactly one H point over every rational s, including ramified rational fibers; #H=q+1. Ordered distinct collision pair ratios s cannot have s³=1 or s⁴=1; inclusion–exclusion gives q-gcd(3,q-1)-gcd(4,q-1). Independent polynomial factorization/algebra and brute-force prime q=5,11,13,17,19,23,31,37,41 corroborate only finite cases.
